title: Average block nonlinear Kaczmarz methods with adaptive momentum for nonlinear systems of equations
summary: The Kaczmarz method is widely recognized as an efficient iterative algorithm for solving large-scale linear systems, owing to its simplicity and low memory requirements. However, the development of its nonlinear extensions for solving large-scale nonlinear systems has seen limited progress. In this work, we introduce a new family of momentum-accelerated averaging block nonlinear Kaczmarz methods tailored for large-scale nonlinear systems and ill-posed problems.
